svg.title: POST /auth/signup — detailed implementation workflow
svg.desc: Level 2 · real functions, middleware and models · badges map to the 9 stages in auth-api-01-register-overview.svg
svg.text: Level 2 · real functions, middleware and models · badges map to the 9 stages in auth-api-01-register-overview.svg

g.text: Shared budget with login and all 4 OTP
The whole document self-deletes if unverified past 10 min.
Plaintext OTP in the email body; failure here throws to the catch-all 500.
All 6 auth routes draw from the same
20-per-15-min IP bucket. A burst of OTP resends
can exhaust the budget a legitimate login attempt
different Mongo documents — the unique index is
from findOne then save, not atomic
Two simultaneous signups for the same new
email can both pass the findOne check; the
loser's save() throws a Mongo E11000
duplicate-key error, caught generically as a 500…
The client only checks fullName is non-empty;
name passes the client and is rejected
Confirmed by reading the schema: an account that
minutes is deleted by MongoDB itself, not by app

svg.text: Heavy arrows are region hand-offs; the cyan one is the HTTP response. Light arrows are steps inside a region. Absent mechanisms — a refresh token, a server session, frontend JWT decoding — are named in a note, never drawn as implemented steps.
A successful signup never signs the user in — see AUTH-API-03 for what happens next, and AUTH-API-02 for the first real login.
